data.name: Smart Train Simulator
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

This is a hardcore train driver simulator built on technologies used in real railway training systems.
No arcade mechanics, no simplifications — only authentic procedures, real-world physics, and strict operational rules.

You operate trains and metro units exactly as real drivers do:
following signals, managing safety systems, respecting schedules, and taking full responsibility for every decision.

This is not about speed.
This is about precision, discipline, and professionalism.

Early Access Content

At the start of Early Access, the game features:

  • Moscow Metro recreated with authentic infrastructure

  • Realistic metro rolling stock with fully functional cabs

  • Operational safety systems and real control logic

  • Core progression systems and mission framework

  • Free movement outside the cab: stations and depots

Early Access focuses on delivering a stable, realistic core experience and refining simulation depth together with the community.

Full Release Vision

The full release expands the simulator beyond metro operations:

  • Real-world British railway routes

  • Mainline trains with authentic signaling and regulations

  • New rolling stock and railway systems

  • Expanded career progression and advanced challenges

New routes, trains, and scenarios will continue to be added over time.

Mission Types

The game includes four mission categories, designed for both learning and mastery:

  • Training Missions
    Structured tutorials based on real driver training programs.

  • Story Missions
    Narrative-driven scenarios inspired by real operational situations.

  • Linear Missions
    Strictly defined routes with schedules, procedures, and objectives.

  • Expert Missions
    Maximum realism, minimal assistance, full responsibility for failures.

Driver Progression & Rating

  • Driver experience and level system

  • Performance-based rating system

  • Evaluation of rule compliance, safety, and driving accuracy

  • Penalties for violations, rewards for professional operation

Your rating reflects how close you are to a real professional driver.

Simulation Depth

  • Authentic train physics and braking models

  • Realistic and dynamic weather conditions

  • Detailed stations, depots, and railway environments

  • Ability to leave the cab and explore operational areas

Every system is designed to behave as it would in real railway operation.

Built by Industry Professionals

The simulator is developed by a team with real-world experience in railway software and professional training simulators.
Accuracy, realism, and technical authenticity are the foundation of every design decision.

This is a simulator made by professionals — for those who value realism.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 @ 3.5 GHz or similar AMD
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 or similar AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 @ 3.5 GHz or similar AMD
  • Memory: 18 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 or similar AMD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended
